steps: Blend the oats into flour, then blend in the banana, egg whites and whey until smooth.
Rest the batter 2 minutes so the oats soak up the liquid.
Cook small pancakes in a non-stick pan over medium-low, about 2 minutes a side.
Top with blueberries and maple syrup.
recipes.note: Low heat keeps them from browning before the middle sets.

steps: Brown the turkey with sage, fennel, salt and pepper until cooked through.
Push it aside and scramble the eggs in the same pan.
Warm the tortilla, fill with turkey, egg, cheese and salsa, and roll tightly.
Toast seam-side down 1 minute so it holds.
recipes.note: Make five, wrap in foil and freeze; reheat 2 minutes in the microwave.

steps: Toast the bagel.
Spread with cream cheese.
Layer salmon and cucumber, then dill, capers and a squeeze of lemon.
Layer half the yogurt, half the berries and half the granola in a glass.
Repeat, then drizzle with honey.
recipes.note: Add the granola last if you pack it for later, or it goes soft.

recipes.n: Veggie egg white omelette with feta
ing: A big handful of spinach (40 g)
steps: Soften the pepper in the oil for 2 minutes, then wilt the spinach.
Whisk the whites and egg, pour over and cook on low until almost set.
Scatter feta on one half, fold and slide onto a plate.
Serve with the toast.
Toast the bread.
Spread with peanut butter, top with banana and cinnamon.
recipes.note: Add a glass of milk for about 8 g more protein.

steps: Bring a pan of water to a gentle simmer and poach the eggs 3 minutes.
Toast the bread and mash the avocado with lemon and salt.
Spread, top with the eggs and chilli flakes.
recipes.note: Crack each egg into a cup first; slide it in gently for neat whites.

steps: Spoon the cottage cheese into a bowl.
Top with pineapple and pumpkin seeds.
Heat the oven to 180C / 350F.
Whisk milk, eggs, maple, whey, cinnamon and baking powder; stir in the oats and blueberries.
Pour into a greased dish and bake 30 minutes until set.
Cut into four and keep in the fridge up to 4 days.
Soften the onion and pepper in the oil, then add the spices for 30 seconds.
Pour in the tomatoes and simmer 8 minutes until thick.
Make four wells, crack in the eggs, cover and cook 5-6 minutes.
Crumble over the feta and serve with the bread.
recipes.note: Take it off while the yolks still wobble.

steps: Stir chia, milk, yogurt and honey together; stir again after 5 minutes to break up clumps.
Refrigerate overnight.
Top with the mango.
Warm the quinoa with the almond milk and cinnamon for 5 minutes.
Top with berries, almonds and honey.
recipes.note: Cook a batch of quinoa on Sunday and this takes 5 minutes.

steps: Heat the oven to 180C / 350F and grease a 6-hole muffin tin.
Whisk eggs and whites; stir in vegetables, cheese and seasoning.
Fill the cups and bake 18-20 minutes until set.
recipes.note: Three muffins a serving; they keep 4 days in the fridge.

steps: Fry the onion and mushrooms in the oil until golden.
Crumble in the tofu with turmeric, cumin and salt; cook 5 minutes.
Stir in the spinach until wilted and serve with toast.
Blend the frozen fruit, whey and a splash of milk until thick; add milk only as needed.
Pour into a bowl and top with granola and chia.
recipes.note: Less liquid makes it spoonable, not drinkable.

steps: Whisk egg, whites, milk and cinnamon; soak each slice 20 seconds a side.
Cook in the butter over medium heat, 2-3 minutes a side.
Top with yogurt, strawberries and maple syrup.

recipes.n: Savoury oats with egg and spinach
steps: Simmer the oats in the stock 4 minutes, stirring.
Stir in the spinach and parmesan.
Top with a fried or soft-boiled egg and black pepper.
recipes.note: Tastes like risotto; the stock does the work.

ing: A few slices of avocado (30 g)
steps: Warm the beans with a spoon of salsa.
Fry the eggs in the oil.
Warm the tortillas, top with beans, eggs, the rest of the salsa and avocado.
Scramble the eggs and whites softly.
Warm the beans and tortillas.
Fill each tortilla with beans, egg, cheese and salsa.
Cook the sweet potato in the oil, covered, 8 minutes until nearly soft.
Add turkey, pepper, onion and spices; cook until the turkey is done.
Make two wells, crack in the eggs, cover 4 minutes.
Stir everything except the walnuts together in a jar.
Refrigerate overnight; top with walnuts in the morning.

recipes.n: Ricotta toast with honey and berries
steps: Toast the bread.
Spread thickly with ricotta; top with berries and honey.
Cook the egg and whites together in a small round, like a patty.
Toast the muffin; stack egg, cheese and spinach.
recipes.note: A mug works as a mould: microwave the eggs 60-70 seconds.

steps: Spoon skyr into a bowl; top with banana, walnuts and honey.
Heat the oven to 180C / 350F.
Mash the bananas; whisk in eggs, milk and whey, then the oats, cinnamon and baking powder.
Pour into two ramekins, top with walnuts and bake 22-25 minutes.
Heat the grill. Cook onion and mushrooms in the oil until golden; wilt the spinach.
Pour in the beaten eggs and parmesan; cook on low 6 minutes.
Finish under the grill 2-3 minutes until puffed. Serve with toast.
Blend everything until smooth.
Blend oats, egg, yogurt, whey, milk and 1/2 tsp baking powder.
Cook in a hot greased waffle iron until crisp.
Top with strawberries and maple syrup.
Warm the rice.
Top with salmon, halved egg, cucumber and avocado.
Finish with soy sauce and sesame seeds.
Scramble the whites with the spinach.
Warm the tortilla; fill with turkey, egg and salsa and roll.
Stir oats, milk, chia and peanut butter in a jar.
Top with the mashed strawberries and refrigerate overnight.
Blend cottage cheese, eggs and oats until smooth.
Cook small pancakes over medium-low, 2 minutes a side.
Serve with blueberries and maple syrup.
Boil the eggs 9 minutes, cool and halve.
Warm the pita and plate everything with the hummus.
Cook the oats in the milk 4 minutes.
Off the heat, stir in whey and cocoa (whey clumps if it boils).
Top with banana and peanut butter.
Warm the tomato in the oil 2 minutes.
Add the beaten eggs and stir gently on low until just set.
Pile onto toast with basil and parmesan.
Stir muesli, milk and grated apple; leave 5 minutes to soften.
Top with yogurt.
Warm the rice and beans.
Scramble the eggs.
Bowl it up with salsa, avocado and cheese.

ing: A big handful of spinach (40 g)
steps: Blend until completely smooth, about 45 seconds.
recipes.note: The banana hides the spinach entirely.

steps: Simmer quinoa, milk, apple and cinnamon 8 minutes until creamy.
Top with almond butter and maple syrup.
Heat the oven to 150C / 300F with a tray of water on the bottom rack.
Blend whites and cottage cheese; stir in cheese and vegetables.
Pour into a greased muffin tin and bake 22 minutes.
recipes.note: The steam tray is what makes them soft, not rubbery.

steps: Scramble the eggs softly on low heat.
Off the heat, fold in the salmon and cream cheese.
Serve on toast with chives.
Blend everything with a few ice cubes.

ing: 60 g mashed pumpkin or sweet potato
steps: Cook oats in the milk with the mash and spices 4 minutes.
Top with maple syrup and seeds.
Crumble and fry the tofu with pepper and spices 6 minutes.
Warm the beans and tortilla; fill, add salsa and roll.
Whisk chickpea flour with 100 ml water, cumin and salt; rest 5 minutes.
Cook in the oil like a thin pancake, 3 minutes a side.
Fill with spinach and tomato; serve with yogurt.
Scramble the eggs with oregano.
Stuff the warm pita with eggs, feta, tomato and cucumber.
Heat the oven to 180C / 350F.
Blend oats to flour; mix with yogurt, eggs, whey, honey and baking powder.
Fold in blueberries, fill 12 muffin cups and bake 20 minutes.
recipes.note: Two muffins a serving.

steps: Blend until smooth.
Roast or pan-fry the potatoes in half the oil 12 minutes.
Sear the seasoned steak 3 minutes a side; rest 5 minutes.
Fry the eggs and plate it all together.
Simmer oats in the milk 4-5 minutes.
Top with walnuts, maple syrup and yogurt.
Season and cook the chicken 6 minutes a side; rest and slice.
Stir yogurt, lemon, garlic, mustard and half the parmesan into a dressing.
Toss the lettuce in it, fill the wrap with chicken and the rest of the parmesan, and roll.
recipes.note: The yogurt dressing saves about 150 kcal over bottled Caesar.

steps: Mash the avocado onto one slice and mustard onto the other.
Layer turkey, tomato and lettuce; close and cut.
Mix tuna, yogurt, celery, lemon and pepper.
Fill the bread with the tuna and lettuce.
Grill the seasoned chicken and slice.
Whisk olive oil, lemon, oregano and salt.
Toss quinoa, vegetables, feta and parsley with the dressing; top with chicken.
recipes.note: Keeps 3 days in the fridge.

steps: Soften onion and carrot in the oil 6 minutes; add the spices.
Add lentils, tomatoes and stock; simmer 15 minutes.
Blend half for body and serve with bread.
Sear the shrimp in the oil 2 minutes a side.
Toss mango, cucumber, lime, chilli and coriander into a salsa.
Serve shrimp over rice with the salsa and avocado.
Rinse the chickpeas; chop the vegetables.
Toss everything with olive oil, lemon, salt and pepper.
recipes.note: Better after an hour in the fridge.

steps: Brown the beef with the spices and a splash of water.
Warm the beans and corn.
Build bowls: rice, beef, beans, corn, lettuce and salsa.
Cut the chicken into bites and sear in the sesame oil.
Add the teriyaki and cook until sticky.
Steam the broccoli; serve over rice.
Rub the chicken with oregano, garlic and lemon; grill and slice.
Grate some cucumber into the yogurt with garlic for tzatziki.
Stuff the pita with chicken, tomato, onion and tzatziki.
Cube the salmon and toss with soy and sesame oil.
Arrange over the rice with edamame, cucumber and avocado.
recipes.note: Use salmon sold for raw eating, or sear it first.

steps: Press and cube the tofu; pan-fry until golden.
Rinse the soba in cold water.
Toss noodles and vegetables with soy, sesame, lime and ginger; top with tofu.
Brown the turkey with onion and pepper.
Add spices, then tomatoes and beans; simmer 25 minutes.
recipes.note: Freezes well in single portions.

steps: Cook and slice the chicken.
Toss cooled pasta with pesto, tomatoes, spinach and mozzarella; add the chicken.
Chop the eggs and mix with yogurt, mustard, salt and pepper.
Spread onto bread with lettuce.
Mash half the beans; spread on half the tortilla with whole beans, corn and cheese.
Fold and toast 3 minutes a side.
Serve with salsa and yogurt.
Grill and slice the chicken.
Arrange everything in rows over the lettuce; drizzle with the dressing.
Soften the vegetables in the oil.
Add the stock and whole chicken breasts; simmer 20 minutes.
Shred the chicken, return it with the noodles and heat through.
Mix tuna with yogurt and sriracha.
Serve over rice with cucumber, edamame and soy.
Spread the wrap with hummus.
Add roughly mashed chickpeas and the vegetables; roll tightly.
Mix turkey, oats, egg and seasoning; roll 10 meatballs.
Brown them, then simmer in marinara 12 minutes.
Fill the rolls, top with mozzarella and grill 2 minutes.
Cook and slice the chicken.
Whisk peanut butter, soy, lime, honey and warm water into a dressing.
Toss the vegetables and chicken in it.
Roast cubed sweet potato with oil and spices at 220C / 425F for 25 minutes.
Warm the beans.
Bowl with quinoa, avocado and salsa.
Slice chicken, peppers and onion; toss with oil and spices.
Cook in a hot pan 8-10 minutes.
Wrap with yogurt and salsa.
Mix yogurt, lemon, salt and pepper.
Toss with cooled pasta, tuna and vegetables.
Sear the steak 3 minutes a side; rest 5 minutes and slice.
Toss greens and vegetables with oil and balsamic; top with steak and feta.
Soften carrot and celery in the oil.
Add tomatoes, stock, beans and zucchini; simmer 20 minutes.
Stir in the pasta; serve with parmesan.
Toss the shrimp in spices and sear 2 minutes a side.
Mix cabbage with yogurt and lime.
Fill warm tortillas with shrimp and slaw.
Marinate the chicken in oil, lemon and spices 10 minutes; roast or pan-fry until charred.
Slice and serve over rice with vegetables and garlic yogurt.
Thin the tahini with lemon and warm water.
Bowl lentils, quinoa and vegetables; pour over the dressing.
Cook and slice the chicken.
Spread pesto in the roll; layer chicken, mozzarella, tomato and spinach. Toast if you like.
Cook and slice the chicken; toss in buffalo sauce.
Wrap with lettuce, celery and yogurt as a cool dip.
Bowl the bulgur and greens.
Top with salmon, cucumber and lemony dill yogurt.
Spread both slices with hummus; layer the vegetables and feta.
Cook and chop the seasoned chicken.
Fill each tortilla with rice, beans, chicken, cheese and salsa; roll tight.
Toast seam-side down.
recipes.note: Wrap in foil to freeze.

steps: Brown the chicken with ginger and garlic.
Add chopped mushrooms and carrot, then soy and sesame oil.
Spoon into lettuce leaves; rice on the side.

tools: Two skillets or a panini press
steps: Build the sandwich and press in a hot pan with another pan on top, 3 minutes a side.
Brown the beef; add soy, honey, garlic, ginger and sesame oil and cook until glossy.
Serve over rice with cucumber and kimchi.
Grill and slice the chicken.
Layer with tomato, mozzarella and basil over rocket; drizzle with oil and balsamic.
Toss everything together; season well.
Simmer chicken in the stock with onion and carrot 20 minutes; shred it.
Whisk eggs with lemon juice, temper with a ladle of hot stock, then stir back in off the boil.
Add rice and chicken and warm through.
recipes.note: Never boil after adding the egg, or it scrambles.

steps: Slice and pan-fry the tofu; splash with soy.
Fill the baguette with tofu, pickled carrot, cucumber, coriander and sriracha yogurt.
Boil the potatoes 12 minutes, adding the beans and egg for the last 7.
Arrange with tuna, tomato and lettuce; drizzle with mustard dressing.
Dice chicken, apple and celery; halve the grapes.
Fold with yogurt and walnuts; serve on lettuce.
Sear the shrimp.
Toss quinoa, corn, tomato and avocado with lime and oil; top with shrimp.
Bake the sweet potato at 200C / 400F for 40 minutes (or microwave 8).
Shred cooked chicken into the BBQ sauce.
Split the potato, fill with chicken, yogurt and scallion.
Stir-fry diced chicken in the oil until cooked; push aside and scramble the eggs.
Add rice, peas and carrot; toss on high heat 4 minutes.
Finish with soy and scallions.
recipes.note: Day-old rice fries; fresh rice turns mushy.

steps: Simmer chicken in the stock with tomatoes and spices 20 minutes; shred.
Add beans and corn.
Top bowls with baked tortilla strips and avocado.
Mix tuna with oil, lemon, onion and capers.
Stuff the pita with tuna and vegetables.
Soften onion and carrot in the oil; add tomatoes, beans and stock.
Simmer 15 minutes, mash a few beans to thicken.
Add the pasta and serve with parmesan.

recipes.n: Lemon herb chicken thighs and potatoes
steps: Heat the oven to 210C / 410F. Toss halved potatoes in half the oil and roast 15 minutes.
Add the chicken rubbed with lemon, garlic and herbs; roast 20 minutes.
Add the beans for the last 8 minutes.
Soften finely chopped onion and carrot in the oil.
Brown the turkey; stir in tomato paste, then the tomatoes; simmer 20 minutes.
Toss with the pasta; finish with parmesan.

recipes.n: Garlic shrimp with rice and broccoli
steps: Steam the broccoli.
Melt the butter, sizzle the garlic 30 seconds, add the shrimp 2 minutes a side.
Finish with lemon; serve with rice and broccoli.
Roast sweet potato wedges in oil at 210C / 410F for 15 minutes.
Add the cod with lemon and paprika and the beans; roast 12 minutes more.
recipes.note: Cod is done when it flakes at the thickest part.

ing: Garam masala, cumin, turmeric, ginger, garlic
steps: Coat the chicken in half the yogurt and spices; sear until charred.
Soften the onion with the rest of the spices; add tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes.
Stir in coconut milk and the chicken; off the heat, stir in the remaining yogurt. Serve with rice.
Brown the beef with onion and pepper.
Add spices, tomatoes and beans; simmer 30 minutes.
Serve over rice.
Heat the oven to 190C / 375F. Halve and seed the peppers.
Brown turkey and onion; mix with rice and half the marinara.
Fill the peppers, top with the rest of the sauce and cheese; bake 25 minutes.
Brush the salmon with teriyaki; bake at 200C / 400F for 12 minutes, brushing again halfway.
Steam the broccoli; serve over rice with scallions.
Roast the chopped vegetables in oil at 210C / 410F for 15 minutes.
Brush the pork with mustard and honey; sear, then roast with the veg 18-20 minutes to 63C / 145F.
Rest 5 minutes and slice.
Slice everything thin; toss with oil, spices and lime.
Cook in a very hot pan in two batches so it chars instead of steaming.
Serve with warm tortillas, yogurt and salsa.
Pan-fry the cubed tofu until golden; set aside.
Fry the curry paste 1 minute, add coconut milk and vegetables; simmer 8 minutes.
Return the tofu, wilt the spinach; serve with rice.
Brown the beef with the spices and a splash of water.
Warm the tortillas; fill with beef, lettuce, tomato, cheese and salsa.
Sizzle garlic in the oil, add tomatoes and simmer 5 minutes.
Add shrimp for 3 minutes, then spinach until wilted.
Toss with the pasta and parmesan.
Heat the oven to 220C / 425F. Butterfly the chicken, dip in egg, then crumbs mixed with parmesan.
Bake 18 minutes; top with marinara and mozzarella, bake 5 more.
Serve with spaghetti tossed in warm marinara.
Mix turkey, oats, egg, garlic, herbs and half the parmesan; roll 20 meatballs.
Bake at 200C / 400F for 15 minutes, then simmer in marinara 5 minutes.
Serve over spaghetti with the rest of the parmesan.
Soften onion, carrot and chopped mushrooms in the oil 8 minutes.
Add tomatoes and lentils; simmer 15 minutes.
Toss with pasta; add parmesan.
Sear the chicken in the oil until browned and cooked.
Add honey, soy and garlic; bubble until sticky.
Serve with rice and steamed beans.
Roast the potatoes in oil at 220C / 425F for 25 minutes; add asparagus for the last 8.
Sear the steaks 3-4 minutes a side, basting with butter, garlic and thyme.
Rest 5 minutes.
Roast the salmon at 200C / 400F for 12 minutes.
Steam the broccoli; serve with quinoa and lemon.
Fry garlic and chilli, add the chicken and beans; cook 6 minutes.
Add soy and honey, then a big handful of basil.
Serve over rice with a fried egg.
Stir-fry the chicken on high heat until done; remove.
Stir-fry the vegetables 3 minutes with ginger and garlic.
Add noodles, chicken, soy and sesame oil; toss.
Soften the onion; add spices, sweet potato, chickpeas and tomatoes.
Simmer 20 minutes until the potato is soft; stir in spinach.
Serve over couscous.
Brown the seasoned chicken pieces; remove.
Soften pepper, onion and celery; add tomatoes.
Fold in the rice and chicken until hot.
Roast salmon, tomatoes and sliced zucchini with oil and oregano at 200C / 400F for 12 minutes.
Serve over couscous with feta and lemon.
Boil and mash the sweet potatoes with the milk.
Brown turkey and onion; add carrot, peas, paste and stock; simmer 10 minutes.
Top with mash and bake at 200C / 400F for 20 minutes.
Sear the beef quickly in batches; remove.
Cook onion and mushrooms until brown; add stock and mustard; reduce by half.
Off the heat stir in yogurt and the beef; serve over noodles.
recipes.note: Take it off the heat before the yogurt, or it splits.

steps: Boil the potatoes 12 minutes, adding the beans for the last 4.
Spread the salmon with pesto and bake at 200C / 400F for 12 minutes.
Cook and slice the chicken; steam the broccoli.
Melt butter, cook garlic and flour 1 minute; whisk in milk and simmer until thick; stir in parmesan.
Toss pasta, chicken and broccoli in the sauce.
Stir-fry the shrimp; remove.
Scramble the eggs, add rice and vegetables on high heat.
Return the shrimp, add soy and scallions.
Slice the pork thin and stir-fry on high until browned.
Add peppers, onion and ginger for 3 minutes.
Glaze with soy and honey; serve over rice.
Marinate chicken cubes in oil, lemon, garlic and oregano 15 minutes; thread onto skewers.
Grill 10-12 minutes, turning.
Serve with rice, tomato and cucumber tzatziki.

recipes.n: Chicken black bean stuffed sweet potatoes
steps: Bake the sweet potatoes 40 minutes at 200C / 400F.
Shred cooked chicken; warm with beans and salsa.
Stuff the potatoes; top with cheese and yogurt.
Dust the cod in seasoned flour; pan-fry in the oil 3 minutes a side.
Toss cabbage with yogurt and lime.
Build tacos with cod and slaw.
Toss beef and vegetables in oil and spices; thread onto skewers.
Grill 8-10 minutes, turning.
Serve over rice.

ing: Red enchilada sauce or salsa (250 g)
steps: Poach and shred the chicken; mix with beans and half the sauce.
Fill and roll the tortillas into a dish; pour over the rest of the sauce and cheese.
Bake at 190C / 375F for 20 minutes. Serve with yogurt.
Press and cube the tofu; fry until crisp on all sides.
Stir-fry the broccoli 3 minutes; add a splash of water to steam.
Add tofu, soy, honey, ginger and garlic; toss and serve with rice.
Mix salmon, oats, egg, lemon and seasoning; shape 4 patties and chill 10 minutes.
Pan-fry in the oil 4 minutes a side.
Serve with potatoes, salad and dill yogurt.

ing: 500 g cooked arborio (from about 200 g dry)
steps: Brown the chicken pieces and mushrooms; remove.
Soften the onion, toast the rice, then add stock a ladle at a time, stirring, for 18 minutes.
Stir in chicken, mushrooms and parmesan.

recipes.n: Turkey burgers with sweet potato wedges
steps: Roast sweet potato wedges in oil at 220C / 425F for 25 minutes.
Shape two patties; cook 5 minutes a side to 74C / 165F.
Build the burgers with lettuce, tomato and mustard.
Pan-fry the tilapia in half the butter 3 minutes a side.
Add the rest of the butter, garlic and lemon; spoon over.
Serve with rice and sauteed zucchini.
Brown the chicken; remove.
Soften the onion with the spices; add tomatoes and lentils; simmer 15 minutes.
Return the chicken, wilt the spinach; serve with rice.
Brown the beef; add beans and half the salsa.
Fill tortillas with rice and beef; roll into a dish.
Top with the rest of the salsa and cheese; bake 15 minutes at 200C / 400F.

recipes.n: Cajun shrimp with rice and peas
steps: Toss shrimp in Cajun spice; sear 2 minutes a side.
Warm rice with peas and pepper; top with shrimp and lemon.
Roast sweet potato and apple wedges in oil at 200C / 400F for 15 minutes.
Brush pork with mustard and maple; add and roast 20 minutes to 63C / 145F.
Simmer stock with ginger, garlic and mushrooms 10 minutes; whisk in miso and soy.
Poach the chicken in it 12 minutes; slice.
Add bok choy for 2 minutes; serve over noodles with the halved eggs.
Slice the eggplant, dip in egg and crumbs; bake at 220C / 425F for 20 minutes.
Layer with marinara and cheeses; bake 20 minutes more.
Serve with pasta.
Soften the onion with the spices.
Add chickpeas, tomatoes and coconut milk; simmer 12 minutes.
Stir in spinach; serve with rice.

ing: Lots of parsley and mint (5 g)
steps: Grill the seasoned chicken.
Toss quinoa with chopped tomato, cucumber, herbs, oil and lemon.
Slice the chicken over the tabbouleh.
Brown beef and onion; add marinara.
Fold in pasta and dollops of ricotta; top with mozzarella.
Bake at 200C / 400F for 20 minutes.
Mix miso and honey; spread over the cod and bake at 200C / 400F for 12 minutes, then 2 minutes under the grill.
Stir-fry the bok choy in sesame oil; serve with rice.
Slice the apple and dip.
Top the yogurt with honey and walnuts.
Top the cottage cheese with berries.
Cut the vegetables into sticks and dip.
Shake with ice.
Spread the rice cakes, top with banana slices.
Boil 9 minutes, cool in cold water, peel.
recipes.note: Boil six on Sunday; they keep 5 days.

ing: 150 g edamame in pods, shelled weight
steps: Boil or microwave 3 minutes; salt.
Mix and pack.
Roll turkey around cheese and cucumber.
Pack and go.
Mix tuna with yogurt, lemon and pepper; pile onto crackers.
Mix everything; add a splash of milk if dry.
Roll 18 balls; chill 30 minutes.
recipes.note: Three balls a serving; keep in the fridge a week.

steps: Air-pop or pop in a covered pan.
Toss with a little oil and grated parmesan.
Dry the chickpeas well; toss with oil and spices.
Roast at 200C / 400F for 25 minutes, shaking halfway.
Top cucumber rounds with cream cheese, salmon and dill.
Stir until smooth and thick.
Pack and go.
Top and eat.
Pack and go.
Slice the pear; top with ricotta, honey and cinnamon.
Pour kefir over berries or blend.
Spread honeyed yogurt on a lined tray; scatter berries and chocolate.
Freeze 2 hours; break into pieces.
Toast, top with cottage cheese, tomato and pepper.
Thread tomato, basil and mozzarella; drizzle.
Blend with ice.
Melt the chocolate; dip the strawberries; chill.
Plate and eat.
Stir chia, milk and maple; stir again after 5 minutes.
Chill 2 hours; top with raspberries.
Whisk; stir in vegetables and feta.
Bake in 6 greased muffin cups at 180C / 350F for 18 minutes.
recipes.note: Two a serving.

steps: Mash avocado with lime, tomato and salt; dip the vegetables.
Mix and pack.
Stir herbs and salt into the yogurt; dip the vegetables.
Mash the bananas and stir in oats, chips and cinnamon.
Scoop 9 cookies and bake at 180C / 350F for 14 minutes.
recipes.note: Three cookies a serving.

steps: Slice the peach over the cottage cheese.
Mix tuna, yogurt and lemon; spoon into the avocado half.
Spread hummus inside; fill with turkey and cucumber.
Pour and drink.
Top rice cakes with cottage cheese, tomato and pepper.
Pit the dates and fill with almond butter.
Pack and go.
Stir honey into yogurt; coat the berries; freeze on a tray 1 hour.
Toast and spread.
Mix diced chicken, celery, yogurt and mustard.
Halve the cucumber lengthways, scoop out seeds, fill.
Core the apple, sprinkle with cinnamon and bake at 190C / 375F for 20 minutes.
Serve with yogurt and walnuts.
Blend edamame, tahini, lemon, garlic and a splash of water.
Serve with crackers.
Shake whey with milk, pour over ice and cold brew.
Halve the kiwis and scoop; eat with pistachios.
Spread the tortilla, roll around the banana, slice.
Cube the watermelon; crumble over feta and mint.
Top rice cakes with banana slices and honey.
recipes.note: Fast carbs that sit light.

steps: Cook oats in the milk 4 minutes; top with banana and honey.
Toast and spread.
recipes.note: White bread digests faster than wholegrain before training.

steps: Toast and drizzle.
Eat the dates with your coffee.
recipes.note: Caffeine about 30-60 minutes before improves performance for most people.

steps: Cook the chicken; serve with rice and soy.
recipes.note: A proper meal: eat it 2-3 hours out.

steps: Layer and eat.
Blend with ice.
Snack and go.
recipes.note: The salt helps if you sweat a lot.

recipes.n: English muffin, jam and a little PB
steps: Toast; spread thinly with PB and jam.
Microwave the pricked sweet potato 6-7 minutes; split and add maple and cinnamon.

recipes.n: Rice cakes with honey and banana
steps: Top and eat.

recipes.n: Raisins and a glass of milk
steps: Snack and go.
Top rice cakes with mango slices and honey.
Top and eat.
Mix everything; press into a lined tin.
Bake at 180C / 350F for 18 minutes; cool and cut 6 bars.
recipes.note: Low fat on purpose, so they digest fast.

steps: Warm the sauce; toss with pasta.
recipes.note: The classic carb meal for a long session; eat it 2-3 hours out.

steps: Mix honey and mustard; spread and fill.
Eat and drink.
Drink and snack.
recipes.note: Handy on hot days.

steps: Snack and go.
Blend with ice.
recipes.note: Beet nitrate may help endurance; it peaks 2-3 hours after.

steps: Snack and go.
Microwave the pricked potato 7 minutes; salt.
Warm the rice; fry or steam the egg on top; add soy and scallion.
